authority: OWNER-RULINGS AC7 and UPGRADE-2-BUILD-SPEC U7.3. The defaults of U7.3 are adopted as DATA, not code: the benchmark by asset class, the horizons in trading days, what counts as right for each rating word, and how a falsifier, a tripwire and a mispricing read are resolved. The benchmark-by-asset-class defaults are U4.2's (AC4): US equity keyed to SPY; crypto, gold and commodity have no benchmark and are scored on their own return. A subject file may name a different benchmark per sitting (U4.2 override). The correlation of tokens against return is refused below twenty scored rows (AC7). Beside AC7 and U7.3: architect mechanism rulings recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md (U7 audit rounds 2–3, 2026-09-18): the close window after the due date is data (`close_window_days_after_due`, `close_days_before_due_allowed`), an out-of-order same-subject append refuses, a duplicate row id refuses; and (U7 audit round 8, 2026-09-18, closing P-U7-8) an excess return is one window - the subject close and the benchmark close that score one horizon must carry the same as-of date, and a pair from different sessions is refused by the observation gate.
correlation_caveat: n is small; this is a record, not a proof
